GenAiFunction.description: Renders a generic, caller-driven list of proposed next steps. THE AGENT SUPPLIES THE STEPS grounded in the real conversation/CRM data (never invent placeholder tasks): pass a JSON `spec` with optional title/subtitle/badges, an optional summary callout, and a `steps` array. Each step: title (required) plus optional detail, rationale, meta, iconName, iconColor, priorityLabel, priorityVariant, and a per-step action link (showCta/ctaLabel/ctaUrl). Give EACH step a per-step action link (ctaLabel + ctaUrl) so it is actionable — a short imperative like "Ouvrir le devis" or "Appeler le client". STRICT VOCABULARIES — use these EXACT tokens only, never CSS colors or SLDS names: badge.variant and priorityVariant = one of [primary, success, warning, danger, neutral] (NOT "info"/"critical"/"high"); iconColor = one of [success, warning, danger, default] (NOT "blue"/"green"/"purple"); iconName = a Lucide slug from [phone, mail, file-text, clipboard-list, calendar, clock, bell, user, users, building, credit-card, check-circle, activity, trending-up] (NOT "document"/"call"/"assessment"). Any other value renders grey or blank. The action auto-numbers step order into the typed payload the card renders. Call with no spec to render a neutral empty placeholder.
